edits.anchor: a social detail is not a finding.
edits.html:
Unchecked attributeIntramuscular ceftriaxone and oral azithromycin — this treats gonorrhea and chlamydia, which give mucopurulent discharge, not white discharge; in a prepubertal child past the newborn period either infection also prompts a sexual abuse evaluation.
Unchecked attributeOral acyclovir — herpes simplex virus gives painful vesicles on a red base; this perineum has no vesicles or pustules.
Salient decoyOral amoxicillin — burning with urination suggests cystitis, but redness over the vulva and perineum with white discharge points to candidal vulvovaginitis.
True-fact-wrong-slotOral metronidazole — it treats bacterial vaginosis and trichomoniasis but has no activity against Candida.
